text:
maria_nguyen: deploybot just bumped engine bundle `quant-v5.3+abi11` into regional swap for us in us-west-2, but canary telemetry popped a small error spike. I'm going to request a temporary pin for safety. Anyone on call? :eyes:

aj: on call, looking now. what metrics are you seeing?

deploybot: ACTION: Quarantine started for bundle quant-v5.3+abi11 on 12 hosts in cluster-usw2. Auto-pin TTL=6h. Reason: elevated 5xx + kv-cache miss spike. (run `deploybot status 1749991234` for details)

sre-bot: quick metrics snapshot: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/canary/1749991234 — 95th latency +5% over baseline, error-rate 0.9% (baseline 0.2%). Heatmap shows small thermal spike on GPU nodes 3-5.

samuel: can you paste the tail of the canary logs? curious if we're seeing OOM or kernel-level assertions.

maria_nguyen: tail snippet from canary agent:
```
[2026-03-21T03:05:12Z] runtime: kv_cache_miss=0.42 err=0.001 op=matmul
[2026-03-21T03:05:18Z] kernel: aten_mm_cuda(): warning: slower kernel selected
[2026-03-21T03:05:22Z] oom_killer: invoked on pid 8421, runtime-engine
[2026-03-21T03:05:23Z] runtime: serving_error=OOM seq_len=2048 model=quant-v5.3
```

liam: OOM is alarming. Could be a quantization memory regression vs v5.2. If OOMs are in canary, I'd prefer a rollback unless we can repro locally quickly.

ops_ryn: agree we shouldn't expand this without root cause. Suggest shorten auto-pin TTL to 2h and run a dedicated repro job on a node with same kernel/driver. Also update release notes to mark "do not upgrade" until confirmed.

aj: short repro plan: 1) pin 2% traffic to legacy `quant-v5.2` route 2) run headroom job: `scripts/repro/alloc_stress.sh --seq 2048 --iters 50` on a staging gpu node 3) collect nvml and dmesg. I can kick off step 2 now.

maria_nguyen: thanks. Action items:
- @deploybot: reduce pin TTL to 2h (manual override)
- @aj: run headroom repro and paste results here
- @sre-bot: create anomaly alert ticket and attach canary traces
- @ops_ryn: prepare rollback play (pin traffic back to v5.2) if repro matches canary

deploybot: UPDATE: Pin TTL set to 2h by maria_nguyen. Quarantine remains.

samuel: repro started. early logs show repeated allocations near 6.4GB then spike to 12.8GB before oom. sending nvml snapshots.

liam: rollback criteria proposal (vote): if repro shows OOM or >3% 5xx sustained over 5 minutes, rollback to quant-v5.2 across affected region. +1 from me.

aj: +1. Also recommend adding a temporary canary throttle at 1% traffic to catch any cross-region ripple.

ops_ryn: +1. I'll draft a short release-note blurb: "DO NOT UPGRADE: quant-v5.3 shows increased memory usage in narrow high-seq workloads; mitigation in progress."

maria_nguyen: consensus reached. timeline: repro results within 20m, if match -> ops executes rollback play and we notify product/infra. I'll update release notes and escalate to eng leads. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
